name: Sumire
source:
Main character suddenly gets in a situation set by his father when he has to live alone with three bride candidates under the same roof for several weeks.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公突然陷入了父亲设下的局面——他必须与三位新娘候选人同在一个屋檐下独处数周。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
